capabilities.evidence: Discovery and scenario tests execute the same artifact hash.
The executable artifact bundles one validation and error implementation.
MCP exposes tools; it does not activate a client custom-agent surface.
The server retains the file in the artifact but does not claim that MCP executes client skill Markdown.
Gateway policy and content-free runtime telemetry map the policy intent, not the client hook process.
Local context remains on the device unless the user explicitly discloses it.
The company runtime can provide governed shared evidence and provenance.
MCP cannot replace every client-native interaction or approval surface.
